values.meaning: bonus physical damage on basic attacks, in place of the usual critical strike damage bonus
values.quote: '''Ashe's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{critical damage|0 to 100|0 to 100|critScaling=true}} of the {{as|attack's damage}}.
values.binNote: Literal transcription only, not a validated formula: the bin is AshePassive#DamageBonus = 1 + (1 + 1 x StatA) x critDamage, then {da9201cc} = DamageBonus x ad. StatA prints as 'bonus cooldownReduction' with a '?' flag (no such stat exists in the allowed list, so it is reported here as 'other'); the sheet also flags the final critDamage reference with '?'. The formula multiplies (1 + StatA) by critDamage rather than adding them, so base=1 plus these two coef-1 terms is the ingredients as printed, not an algebraic reconstruction (1 + StatA + critDamage != 1 + (1+StatA) x critDamage). The wiki gives no authored numbers either, only a prose range ('0 to 100'), so neither source yields a checkable closed-form ratio here; see top.json unsettled.
